rubric_hint.basis: prompts/rubric.md v1 applied to all rings 0-1000 m and effort; a default, not a verdict

reasons.claim: Eligible VU lichen Alectoria sarmentosa (forest-associated, site-bound; threats include lack of continuity forest and large/old trees): 2 records, nearest 462 m, both from 2016. None within 250 m, so MEDIUM.

Several NT site-bound forest species recorded 394-856 m away (e.g. Carbonicola myrmecina, Crossocalyx hellerianus, Calicium denigratum, Hertelidea botryosa, Bryoria nadvornikiana). All lie beyond 250 m, so the 3-species NT rule is not met; they are supporting context only.
Effort is at the county median (66 records, 50th percentile) but there are no records inside the polygon or within 250 m, so near-site absence is weakly informative.
No completed felling overlaps the polygon.

uncertainties: The nearby threatened and NT records are mostly from 2016, so current occupancy is unknown.
Records are 394 m or more from the polygon and do not show that the species occupy this stand.
Some nearby records have coordinate uncertainty of 100 m.
not_established: Presence or absence of red-listed species inside the polygon.
Stand age or quality; no tool output describes it.
That the site is safe to fell.
next_action: Reviewer should check the stand for lichen and old-forest habitat, for example by field inventory, and whether the 2016 cluster 400-600 m away extends toward the polygon.
